excluded_attempts.reason: Cancelled before training: empty CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS overrode RUSTFLAGS. No profiles or evaluated binaries used; all subsequent builds explicitly unset it.

comparison.interpretation: Descriptive process-level comparisons; no significance or speedup claim. Check input, retained work, applied cadence and errors together.

training.purpose: Profile generation only; instrumented timing excluded from A/B

analysis.normalization: Server process CPU seconds / built logical avatar sends * 1e6, calculated per run before median
validation: Eight summaries independently rederived from raw captures
Raw and merged profiles unchanged through evaluation; no new raw profiles
All binary/compiler flag fingerprints and hashes checked before evaluation
Training refused stale raw profiles before launching processes
Two training runs and eight evaluation runs passed all 34 workload/delivery/provenance gates
analysis.automated_review: CodeRabbit analysis unavailable: review quota exhausted (rate_limit). No clean review claimed. Manual inspection and real training/evaluation checks completed.
analysis.raw_note: All observer, sender and global counter CSVs plus process/readiness fields used for metrics and gates retained here. Full health/logs/per-pair CSVs, binaries and profiles retained locally under captures/pgo-client250-20261008 with recorded hashes.
limitations: One host, one trained profile, four evaluation processes per variant; descriptive evidence only
Dense synthetic loopback avatar workload, no voice/P2P/churn/malformed/backpressure/loss/remote network
One observer measures applied cadence, not end-to-end latency or all-receiver delivery
PGO applies to target Rust crates, not automatically native C dependencies or precompiled standard library
Software instrumentation counts are not hardware branch counter measurements
analysis.decision: Observed workload-specific CPU efficiency improvement: median server CPU -4.53%, CPU per million built sends -4.96% (lower in all four pairs), median built work +0.41%; cadence varied and no reliable latency or universal speedup is claimed.

sender_window_variation.note: Every sender generated/sent 3000–3001 items. Run 5 has 750120 socket / 750124 generated items; run 7 has 750140 socket / 750136 generated items. Four records in each differ by one between counters; zero send errors. All runs retained, not exact input equality.
sender_window_variation.interpretation: Counters are sampled individually via relaxed atomics; one-count differences are consistent with snapshots crossing a send, an inference rather than proven cause. All source/log/CSV evidence retained.
